subject: Aligning on next steps: 30-minute walkthrough windows + quick smoke test
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Cox <samira.cox@harborcloud.io>, Tom Nguyen <tnguyen@harborcloud.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: proposed 30-min walkthrough windows + quick pre-demo smoke check

Hi Samira / Tom — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we don’t lose momentum: 

- Outcome: HarborCloud is interested in a short, 30-minute product walkthrough focused on inference latency and cost controls for your ML pipelines.
- Goal for next meeting: show a concise demo (30 min) tailored to your infra questions and surface the controls you can use in-production.

Can you pick one of these 30-minute windows? I’ve left a ~2 hour buffer after each option for any follow-ups.

Option A: Tue 10 Nov, 09:30–10:00 PT
Option B: Wed 11 Nov, 13:00–13:30 PT
Option C: Thu 12 Nov, 16:00–16:30 PT

Two asks from our side before the session if possible:
1) A short sandbox dataset / sample request pattern (or a small curl example) so we can prepare a short smoke test that mirrors your traffic. This helps us demonstrate realistic latency and batching behavior.
2) Please confirm who from your side will be the decision owner and who should join for technical Q&A.

I’ve attached a one-page agenda (redwood-demo-agenda-v1.pdf) and a proposed smoke-test checklist (infrastructure-smoke-test-checklist.xlsx). If a quick smoke check is desirable, we can run that 15–30 minutes before the walkthrough — it’s lightweight and helps avoid surprises.

If you’re good with one of the windows above, I’ll lock it and send a calendar invite with Ben on the invite list (Ben will cover integration/infra details).

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
